PRIVACY NOTICE

How we look after
your information.

Last updated: September 24, 2026

Pashabakess is a small home bakery run by Pasha in Tyngsboro, Massachusetts. This notice explains what the website collects when you order or send an inquiry, why, and what happens to it. Questions? Email pashabakess@gmail.com.

What we collect

  • When you order: your name, email address and phone number; the cookies you choose; your pickup date and time; the occasion and any notes you add; the payment app you choose (Venmo or Cash App); and, if you give it, the name or username you’ll pay from.
  • When you send an inquiry: your name, email address, what it’s about, the event date and quantity if you give them, and your message.
  • When you pay: payments are made in Venmo or Cash App, not on this website, so we never see or store card or bank details. Pasha sees what those apps show her about your payment, such as your payment name, the amount and the note.

How we use it

  • To bake your order, match your payment to it, and arrange your pickup.
  • To email you your order number, payment details and confirmation (including the pickup address), and to reply to your inquiries.
  • To call or text you if something about your pickup needs sorting out.

We don’t sell or rent your information, we don’t use it for advertising, and we don’t send marketing emails.

Where it’s kept and who can see it

  • Orders and inquiries are stored in the website’s database with our web hosting provider. They can only be viewed through a password-protected admin page used by Pasha and the person who maintains the website for her.
  • Order and inquiry emails are sent and received with Pasha’s Gmail account, so copies are kept in that mailbox.
  • Venmo and Cash App handle your payment under their own privacy policies.
  • Pages load fonts from Google Fonts, and two menu photos from the recipe sites credited on the menu, so those services receive technical details such as your IP address when your browser requests them.
  • To stop spam, the website keeps a scrambled (hashed) form of your IP address for a short time. Your actual IP address isn’t stored.

Cookies and storage in your browser

The website doesn’t use advertising or analytics cookies. While you build an order, your box and form details are saved in your browser’s session storage for that tab, so a page refresh doesn’t lose them. They’re cleared when you place your order or close the tab. The only cookie the website sets is a login cookie for Pasha’s admin page.

How long we keep it

We keep order and inquiry records for as long as we need them to run the bakery and keep business records. If you’d like your details deleted sooner, just ask and we’ll delete anything we don’t need to keep.

Your choices

You can ask to see, correct or delete the information we hold about you by emailing pashabakess@gmail.com.

Changes to this notice

If this notice changes, the new version will be posted on this page with a new date.
